Color Picker

The Color Picker renders a swatch from a normal input, opens a preset palette on click, and offers a native color input for fully custom values. Use data-zak-colorpicker to enable it.

Basic Color Picker

Click the swatch to open the palette. Choosing a preset or confirming a custom color writes the hex value to the (hidden) input.

#2563eb
HTML
<input type="text" data-zak-colorpicker value="#3b82f6">

Custom Presets

Pass a comma-separated list of hex values in data-zak-colorpicker-presets to replace the default palette.

HTML
<input type="text"
       data-zak-colorpicker
       data-zak-colorpicker-presets="#0f172a,#475569,#0891b2,#16a34a,#ca8a04,#dc2626,#c026d3,#9333ea"
       value="#0891b2">

Default Preset Palette

With no attribute the picker ships this ten-color default set, which covers the semantic and neutral scales.

Native Fallback

When scripting is disabled the input stays in the DOM. Use a plain <input type="color"> for an inaccessible-JS-safe alternative.

HTML
<input type="color" value="#3b82f6">

CSS Classes

HTML
.zak-colorpicker              /* Wrapper injected around the input */
.zak-colorpicker-swatch        /* Clickable color preview */
.zak-colorpicker-popup         /* Palette popup (hidden until active) */
.zak-colorpicker-presets       /* Grid of preset swatches */
.zak-colorpicker-color         /* Individual preset button */
.zak-colorpicker-color.selected /* Active preset outline */
.zak-colorpicker-custom        /* Custom color row */
.zak-colorpicker-native        /* Native color input */

/* Toggle class */
.zak-colorpicker-popup-active  /* Shows the popup */

JavaScript API

HTML
zak.colorPicker.init()     // Bind all [data-zak-colorpicker] inputs

// Data attributes:
data-zak-colorpicker       // Enables the picker on an input
data-zak-colorpicker-presets // Comma-separated hex palette (optional)

// The input is switched to type="hidden"; its value holds the hex.
// The swatch is a div with role="button" and tabindex="0".

// Event on the input:
zak:change  // { value: "#hexcolor" }

Accessibility

  • The swatch exposes role="button", tabindex="0" and an aria-label set by the component.
  • Preset swatches and the native color input are real interactive elements, operable by keyboard and pointer alike.
  • Clicking outside the popup closes it; the underlying input still submits normally since it holds the hex value.
  • Do not rely on the visual swatch alone — label the field so the color’s purpose is clear to screen-reader users.
